# GQTPE — Nursain Temirtas

> Portfolio of Nursain Temirtas (GQTPE), a Front-end Developer building clean, high-performance interfaces with React and Vue.js.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/): Landing and intro.
- [About](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/about): Bio, experience, education, languages and tech stack.
- [Projects](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/projects): List of featured projects.
- [Contacts](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/contacts): Contact form.

## Projects

- [Spotify clone](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/project/spotify): Music player built with the Spotify Web API.
- [Trello clone](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/project/trello): Task-management pet project.
- [Portfolio](https://gqtpe-portfolio.vercel.app/project/portfolio): This site, built with Vue.
